Digital Food Ordering System in UNIMAS
The Problem
Every day, UNIMAS students waste time
just to find out a stall is closed.
⚠️
No Menu Visibility
Students walk to stalls only to find them closed or items sold out. Wasted trips and wasted time.
⏰️
Long Queues
Manual verbal ordering causes bottlenecks during peak hours, especially between classes.
💸
No Campus Platform
Commercial apps charge high commissions that small campus stalls simply cannot absorb.
The Solution

UNIMAS
FoodHub

A pickup-based Android mobile app that digitalises campus food ordering. No delivery fees, no commissions and no guessing.
